reviewed.reason: Official active SDK with StockDataStream/NewsDataStream and paper sandbox; benchmark latency/coverage before production.
Active MIT library with typed SEC events and 1000+ tests; strong candidate for catalyst/dilution timing challenger.
Excellent deterministic event-time replay/live parity, but direct dependency is too heavy and LGPL/runtime complexity is not justified yet.

marketAudit.measurementGap: Standard discovery-ledger did not contain SOAR, YYGH, CRE or VCIG while live/pre-market evidence showed them as major movers. Because UI also consumes discovery-fast, standard-only ledger can create false Missed classifications.
marketAudit.learningDecision: Fix measurement coverage before changing scoring thresholds. Earliest immutable observation across standard + fast proactive lanes must be the challenger definition of detection. Reactive Top-20 remains evaluation-only.

productionChanges.purpose: Prevent premarket late/exhausted runners from resetting into actionable signals after the regular open.

challengerChanges.purpose: Measure earliest detection across discovery + discovery-fast with immutable event-time fields, classify Top-20 without look-ahead, and quantify fast-only rescues.
challengerChanges.promotionRule: Do not replace champion ledger until multiple snapshots/sessions show improved measurement completeness without timestamp leakage or false early attribution.

nextEvaluation: Compare challenger currentTop20 Early<10/Early<20/Missed against champion ledger after output is produced.
Only if true universe misses remain after dual-lane reconciliation, test a broader discovery lane in sandbox rather than relaxing production ranking thresholds.
